description: This file contains the implementation of the Affiliate model class within the Opencart Admin module. It defines methods for managing affiliate data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate information and reports.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for managing affiliates, including CRUD operations and report handling.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Inserts new affiliate data into the database based on provided data array.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates affiliate information for a given customer ID.

methods.name: editBalance
methods.description: Updates the account balance for a specific affiliate customer.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes an affiliate record and associated reports based on customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves detailed affiliate information for a given customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate data based on the tracking code.

methods.name: getAffiliates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of affiliates with optional filtering.

methods.name: getTotalAffiliates
methods.description: Returns the total count of affiliates matching given filters.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Fetches report data for a specific affiliate customer, with pagination.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries for a specific affiliate customer.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of reports for a given affiliate customer.
